newsitem.title: GERMANY: German police smash armed biker gang.
newsitem.headline: German police smash armed biker gang.

text.p: German police on Thursday broke up a heavily-armed bikers' club called "Born to be Wild", whose members are suspected of smuggling drugs and running a protection racket in the city's tattoo shops.
More than 100 officers stormed the premises of the 15-member motorcycle club and 29 apartments, police and prosecutors said.
They met no resistance, detained eight people and seized weapons including a hand grenade and ammunition.
The investigation has lasted 17 months. Two members of the club were arrested in October on charges of smuggling 22 kg of cannabis resin out of the Netherlands.
Police did not say whether the group had any connections to other international biking clubs.
Over the past three years eight people have been killed in Sweden, Denmark, Norway and Finland in fights between the rival Hells Angels and Bandidos gangs, both offshoots of U.S. bike clans.
